services.name: Daily Charters
services.desc: Seeking the ultimate Alaskan immersion? Our all-inclusive, multi-day private yacht charters are designed for precisely that experience. We'll handle every detail, freeing you to fully relax and embrace your adventure into the wilds of Southeast Alaska.Choose from three to six days of exclusive private cruising for two to four guests. Spend your days fishing, kayaking, or exploring southeast Alaska's small communities and pristine beaches. Return each evening to Sir Reel's comfortable salon and enjoy Alaska-inspired meals and local craft beverages. Get the best sleep of your life in our restful accommodations while anchored in remote coves. Check out our Get The Details page for more

services.name: What To Pack For An Alaskan Cruise
services.desc: Dave and I have been adventuring in southeast Alaska for over a decade. We’ve learned how to stay comfortable in all kinds of weather, and most importantly, we’ve learned how to stay dry on the soggiest of days. If you’re wondering what to pack for an Alaska cruise, we’ve got you covered! Whether you’re visiting southeast Alaska on a big boat or taking one of our private cruises, this post is for you! Keep reading for links and details about our top recommended gear, or download our ‘What To Pack For An Alaska Cruise’ checklist.
